7
Two satellites in deep space collide inelastically.
What happens to the total kinetic energy and total momentum?
total
kinetic energy
total
momentum
A
conserved
conserved
B
conserved
reduced
C
reduced
conserved
D
reduced
reduced

hints: Notice the phrase deep space - it tells you there is no significant external force or friction acting on the two-satellite system during the collision.
Recall what inelastically means for energy: total momentum can still be conserved but some $E_k = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$ is changed into heat and work done deforming the satellites.
Compare the two quantities separately: check impulse on the system for momentum, then check energy transfer out of kinetic store for kinetic energy.
walkthrough: Identify the system as the two satellites together. Deep space means no external resultant force, so the only forces during impact are equal and opposite internal forces between the satellites.
Apply conservation of momentum: with $F_{ext} = 0$, the total impulse is zero, so $p_{initial} = p_{final}$ for the system. Total vector momentum is therefore conserved.
Apply the definition of an inelastic collision: the bodies stick or deform and do not separate with the same relative speed, so kinetic energy is not conserved.
Account for the lost kinetic energy: some $E_k$ does work to crush and heat the satellites and is transferred to thermal and sound stores, so total kinetic energy after is less than before.
Combine the two conclusions: total kinetic energy reduced and total momentum conserved. This is option C.

A.explanation: Inelastic means kinetic energy is not conserved. Some $E_k$ is transferred to heat, sound and permanent deformation of the satellites.

B.explanation: It reverses the physics. Total momentum is conserved when external force is zero, while total kinetic energy is reduced in an inelastic collision.

C.explanation: Deep space gives zero resultant external force so total momentum is conserved, but an inelastic collision converts some kinetic energy to other forms so total kinetic energy is reduced.

D.explanation: Total momentum is not reduced because the collision forces are internal and there is no external impulse in deep space.
